thread:
maria_v: quick sync — noticed some models that pass our smoke + bench still fail in downstream prod when quantized/ported to different runtimes. wondering if we should add an explicit 'portability' gate in the onboarding pipeline.

devin: ugh yeah saw that with the llama-variants last week. differences were subtle — tokenization edgecases + fp->int rounding in the attention kernel. took a long time to root cause.

anita: concrete proposal: after current bench stage, run a lightweight portability pass that validates: (1) tokenization parity on a set of golden prompts, (2) top-k sampling distribution drift for a few seeds, (3) kv-cache replay sanity on short contexts. fail only if >threshold.

maria_v: +1. keep it fast though — we don't want onboarding to balloon. maybe limit to N=64 short prompts and a reduced set of runtimes (pt->onnx->tvm).

samir: can bench-bot run those? bench-bot: yes — I can add a portability job that spins up minimal containers and compares outputs. will need a canonical serializer for outputs to diff.

bench-bot: suggested serializer: line-normalize whitespace, canonicalize unicode, collapse deterministic numeric noise to 3 decimal places for floats. would you like a sample script?

olga: question on policy: if portability fails only on quantized path but hosted fp32 path is fine, do we block onboarding or mark as "restricted" for quantized deployments?

anita: prefer marking as restricted + require a remediation ticket. blocking all onboarding for quantization-only failures seems heavy and will slow customers using fp32.

devin: tradeoff: restricted models will be excluded from auto-quantize/cheap routing. ops needs a clear UI label + rollout rules. also add telemetry to detect customer impact if they request quantized variants.

maria_v: agreed. also add an escape hatch for manual approval by infra/ML if team certifies downstream tests. we should document the portability failure reasons in the ingest UI (tokenizer, sampling, kv-replay).

samir: implementation note: we should reuse existing golden sample store but add a portability-specific golden that focuses on edge tokens and short-form prompts. keeps runtime time low.

devin: one more: add a probabilistic canary after onboarding — 1% traffic routed to quantized variant in prod with heavy logging for 24h. if errors/spikes => auto rollback. low cost but catches mismatches early.

maria_v: perfect. I'll update the onboarding RFC with: new stage name 'portability-gate', criteria, restricted flag, manual override flow, and canary policy. will post draft in #eng-ml for quick review. :thumbsup:

olga: thanks — will coordinate console UX for the restricted label and the remediation actions.

anita: if anyone wants to pair on the serializer and thresholds, ping me.

maria_v: tagging followups: @devin for canary/runbook, @samir for bench-bot changes, @olga for console UX. thanks!
